name: Yamanashi Takayuki
source:
Yamanashi-san is the Migiwa family butler and chauffeur. 

He is a middle-aged man with grey hair and a slim stature. He is shown wearing a black business suit and sun glasses at all times. Mostly solemn, he usually carries out orders and rarely steps out of his role to speak out.
